segments.text: She is a 27-year-old venture business owner and handicrafts artist.

Although her cute appearance gives the impression of being gentle and kind, she is actually quite voracious sexually and her sexual proclivities are intensely dynamic. Due to the early death of her father, whom she loved very much, she has strong father complex tendencies and had no experience with men.

She had never been in a relationship, let alone with a man, until her college days, when by incident she became the mistress of a man about the same age as her father. Which led to her spending her days screwing around with multiple sex partners, famous men with mistresses and random men and women she met on dating apps..
